$comment: The queries each rendered surface reads (ruling D-35). Each key is a collected surface (parity.json `surfaces`, or `menu` for the native menu built from menu.json), so a read belongs to a surface the window renders; the gate refuses any other key (C43B-R2S-01, C43B-R2-01). A query is bound only if a surface here declares it; the gate (crates/executor/tests/common/parity_gate.rs) checks this table both ways against the query call sites the parity test finds in product code (parity.json `callSites`): every call site is declared here, under a surface or under plumbing, and every declared read has a call site in a file it names. Plumbing calls bind nothing.

main.description: the main window's title, mode, start screen and modal state (01 §5.1); the dock: the workspace's arrangement and the panels it shows (01 §5.4, §5.5); the main toolbar and the tool palettes (01 §5.7); the Drawing tools palette's tools (02 §7); the status bar: its texts, the running jobs, the agent indicator and its sessions popover (01 §9.1, 11 §6.4); the History panel (01 §10); a view window's type buttons (01 §5.3); a view window's zoom readout, drawing aids and symmetry (01 §5.3, 02 §6.2, §10); the Drawing and Camera view canvas: its mapping, active view, tools, pens, selection and preferences (02 §4, camera note §6)

startScreen.description: the main window's title, mode, start screen and modal state (01 §5.1); the start screen: recent projects and recovery (01 §2, §3.7)

menu.description: the native menu: accelerators, Open Recent, the workspace list (01 §5.1, §3.3, §5.5)

preferences:general.description: the Preferences window: the values, themes, tips and the shortcut editor's bindings (01 §7, §8.3, §9.4)

dialog:About Toontown.description: About, Project Info, Check Project and Open Backup (01 §3.6, §3.7, §6.7)

dialog:Project Info.description: About, Project Info, Check Project and Open Backup (01 §3.6, §3.7, §6.7)

app.state.get.reason: the host's engine watchdog probes the document thread

prefs.get.reason: the host reads the agent server's port and switch; the window reads the start-up behaviour at launch

project.recent.list.reason: the start-up behaviour 'open the last project' (01 §1.1) reads the most recent project

window.geometry.get.reason: the host applies the stored main-window geometry to the native window

window.panel.list.reason: the host opens and closes the native float windows the kernel's panel list names

job.wait.reason: the New Project form waits for its own creation job; the progress it shows is job.list's
